title: keep the frame rate high and smooth on High and Ultra: a frame-time governor, a first-run benchmark and a perf overlay
lensAText: a sceptical game performance lead and player. Read /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/wf/brief-smooth.md. Look at the builder's frames and logs with the Read tool, then build dist/artifact.html yourself and run ONE short Playwright script at 390x844 (phone viewport copy, DPR 3) and 1280x720: drive 2 minutes on Ultra with the overlay on and an injected frame cost (the test hook) that forces step-downs, then remove it. Judge: does the governor step down in the ladder order and back up without oscillating; are the floors respected (Ultra never blurry below 0.75 scale); is the label 'Ultra · auto' honest; does the benchmark pick sensibly and does the player's choice win; is the overlay readable and off by default; any regression in boot/render/phone/modes. Reject on oscillation, a broken floor, a hidden quality change, or a regression.
